pages.text: Place a $(l)Package$(), put items inside, then seal it with $(l)Packing Tape$().$(br2)Right-click it with a $(l)Stamp$() and enter coordinates or a friend's Locker ID. An enderman delivers it, any distance!
Craft a birdhouse $(l)Locker$() (8 planks around a Stamp), place it and give it an ID. Friends can mail you with just the ID. A letter peeks out when mail arrives!
pages.title: Your Mailbox

pages.text: The $(l)Package Controller$() shows where your package is and whether it arrived.
